meta.representative_year: a snowy modern ChEZ year (continuous cover ~10 Dec-20 Feb), chosen because the brief requires winter = snow only; ~1 winter in 3 is near-snowless in reality (2019/20, 2023/24, 2024/25)
meta.depth_cap_basis: VERIFIED engine_snow.md: tushkan head-top 0.536 (small) / 0.670 / 0.770 m; blind-dog back 0.75-0.79 m, small dog back ~0.66 m, belly 0.41-0.47 m. 0.536 keeps every dog's back above snow; 0.670 would bury a small dog's back
meta.depth_mapping: INFERRED: open, under_trees and roads depths are real-world representative depths (1:1). drifts_neglected peaks exactly at the cap on 15 Feb; real counterpart = lee drifts / abandoned yards in snowy winters 0.35-0.57 m (Bragin / Mozyr extreme of the winter-max dekad 0.52 / 0.57 m, VERIFIED SP 2.04)
meta.rollover: grass cohort year rolls over on ~1 Jan, inside the window where grass_visible = 0 (Dec 15 - Feb 15 keys are all 0). In Jan-Aug 'thatch_*' = last season's dead blades; current-year dead tissue uses straw_* and straw_lodging. thatch_* are held (constant) Aug-Dec when thatch_fraction ~0
meta.interpolation: scalars: periodic monotone cubic (Fritsch-Carlson) over the 12 keys at the 15th (no overshoot; exact zeros stay zero); colours: lerp in LINEAR rgb with the same t (or smoothstep(t)); never Catmull-Rom
meta.grass_visible_runtime: grass_visible = saturate((0.9 - snow.coverage.open) / 0.6) evaluated on the interpolated cover; the keyed values equal this formula. Blades are additionally buried where (blade top - local snow depth) < 0.02-0.03 m

field_defs.new_growth_height: height of the current-season cohort / profile full summer height (grass_profiles.height_summer_m); 0..1
field_defs.green_fraction: share of visible blade area that is live green, both cohorts counted (what QA sees); must be <= 1 - thatch_fraction
field_defs.cohort_green: DERIVED = green_fraction / (1 - thatch_fraction): live share of current-cohort blades (use as 1 - senescence)
field_defs.live_color / yellowing_color / straw_col: sRGB hex of DRY albedo (mid-blade); see colour_library for photo and spectral grounding; wetness darkening is applied by the shader from 'wetness' (Lagarde porosity factor), not baked in
field_defs.thatch_fraction: share of visible blades that are last season's dead blades (spring-summer); old seed heads ride on these blades
field_defs.thatch_lodging: 0 upright .. 1 flat, for the thatch cohort
field_defs.straw_lodging: EXTRA field (not in the brief): lodging of current-year dead blades (summer cure, autumn, early winter)
field_defs.seed_heads: share of the profile's max head density (grass_profiles.head_share_max) carrying CURRENT-year heads
field_defs.seed_stage: 0 none, 0.25 heading, 0.5 anthesis, 0.75 ripe, 1.0 shattered / weathered
field_defs.tip_dryness: dry share of live blade length from the tip
field_defs.wetness: climatological baseline wetness of blades and litter (dew, fog, melt, autumn RH) before live rain; 0..1
field_defs.frost: probability of a frosted-grass morning = P(grass-surface min < 0 C) x clear-sky share (Chornobyl Tmin 1981-2010, grass 4 C below air, sd 3.5 C; Kyiv overcast days)
field_defs.density: blade count relative to the profile's July count
field_defs.burnt_patch_share: typical-year share of profile area showing fresh burn / early regrowth (<~30 d) on the 15th; ~0.001/yr of open land burns in a normal year; megafire years (2015, 2020) are x100-x200
field_defs.flood: floodplain profiles only: share of area under standing water / waterlogged
field_defs.flood_ice: share of that water that is ice-covered

snow_field_defs.coverage: area fraction covered per surface class: open ground, under tree canopy, roads (game rule: compacted and fully covered wherever open ground is covered), drifts_neglected (lee of forest edges, fences, buildings, ditches, abandoned yards)
snow_field_defs.depth_m: depth where snow lies (game metres); roads = compacted depth = max(road_min, open * rho_open / rho_road), except Mar (melt first)
snow_field_defs.depth_real_m: real-world reference (typical conditional open depth, range seen in station data/photos, climatological P(cover) and mean depth incl. snow-free days)
snow_field_defs.albedo_linear / colour: linear albedo and sRGB hex; open = state-weighted (appearance.md 6.2), roads = compacted x dirt tint, under_trees = litter tint
snow_field_defs.grass_visible: global multiplier on blade density; 0 = NOT A SINGLE BLADE
